name: ns_proofsearch_alien_invariant_bridge
rubric_version_reason: Ambitious successor after the residual-defect and pressure-channel-nullity runs. The goal is not another incremental pincer rerun; it is to find a new invariant, proof bridge, explicit packet, or first-blocking theorem that crosses from kinematic diagnostics to PDE-relevant Navier-Stokes structure.
description: Broad theorem-search substrate for an alien invariant, monotone/exhaust functional, pressure-active residual-stable packet, or no-go theorem for the current Navier-Stokes proof fork.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative frontier theorem-search substrate over possible invariants, packet certificates, and PDE bridge obligations.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by theorem burden, invariant quality, and counterexample quality, not formula gaps.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: Qualitative theorem-search substrate; do not route as numerical fit primitive.
persona: You are a ruthless alien-math PDE theorem-search referee in Newton mode. Do not merely restate the current Navier-Stokes pincer, residual-defect, or pressure-channel-nullity results. The goal is a frontier bridge: find a new invariant, monotone/exhaust functional, compactness obstruction, pressure-active residual-stable packet, or first-blocking theorem that materially changes the proof graph. You may propose alien coordinates, gauge/topology, information/entropy, Lagrangian recurrence, microlocal defect measures, frame-rotation variables, or renormalized packet economics, but every proposal must cash out in PDE-facing obligations: explicit definitions, a sign or monotonicity inequality, residual-defect or pressure-reconstruction interface, scope limits, and a falsifier. Reward bold theorem packets that either cross the bridge or honestly prove why the bridge cannot cross. Penalize inspirational analogies, metric-kernel substitution, envelope-only pincer repeats, pressure-gauge artifacts, approximate-equals-exact laundering, and regularity/blowup overclaims.

dimensions.name: Alien Invariant Ambition
dimensions.description: Does the submission propose a genuinely new invariant, coordinate, monotone quantity, compactness object, or packet economics beyond the current residual/pincer restatement?

dimensions.name: PDE Cash-Out Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the invariant cash out as a theorem-facing Navier-Stokes obligation: sign, monotonicity, compactness, pressure reconstruction, residual-defect control, or explicit packet construction?

dimensions.name: Bridge Across Current Fork
dimensions.description: Does it materially connect to the current fork: high-normal resupply vs escape/viscosity, residual-defect realization, pressure-channel nullity, or reset-residual cancellation?

dimensions.name: Explicit Object Specificity
dimensions.description: Does it define concrete objects U_n, functionals, measures, sections, return maps, pressure sources, or invariant variables precisely enough to falsify?

dimensions.name: Adversarial Falsifier Quality
dimensions.description: Does it name what would kill the proposal, including rival packet families, gauge artifacts, reset-residual costs, pressure-active evaders, or compactness escapes?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a theorem packet, explicit construction, no-go theorem, Lean-facing object list, or next decisive discriminator?

dimensions.name: Scope Honesty And Nonclaim Control
dimensions.description: Does it avoid Clay-level overclaim, separate regularity/blowup implications from local theorem objects, and keep domain assumptions explicit?

dimensions.name: Proof Cost Reranking
dimensions.description: Does it say whether the route is cheaper than pressure taxonomy, explicit packet construction, or Lean formalization of existing scaffolds?

criteria.Alien_Invariant_Ambition: Full credit requires a genuinely new invariant, coordinate, monotone quantity, compactness object, or packet economics beyond restating residual-defect or pincer algebra.
criteria.PDE_Cash_Out_Discipline: Full credit requires converting the invariant into a Navier-Stokes-facing theorem obligation: sign, monotonicity, pressure reconstruction, residual-defect control, compactness, or packet construction.
criteria.Bridge_Across_Current_Fork: Full credit requires materially addressing the current live fork: high-normal resupply vs signed escape/viscosity, residual-defect realization, pressure-channel nullity, or reset-residual cancellation.
criteria.Explicit_Object_Specificity: Full credit requires concrete definitions of fields, functionals, sections, measures, return maps, pressure sources, or variables that can be falsified.
criteria.Adversarial_Falsifier_Quality: Full credit requires naming the precise family or mechanism that would kill the proposal and the cheapest discriminator that would reveal it.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a theorem packet, construction, no-go theorem, Lean-facing object list, or next decisive discriminator.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Nonclaim_Control: Reject regularity/blowup overclaims, pressure-gauge artifacts, metric-kernel substitution, envelope-only repeats, and approximate-equals-exact laundering.
criteria.Proof_Cost_Reranking: Full credit requires comparing the proposal's proof cost to the current alternatives and saying why it should or should not supersede pressure taxonomy or packet construction.

success_criteria: A new invariant or functional with a plausible sign, monotonicity, compactness, or coercivity theorem that attacks the live NS fork.
An explicit pressure-active or cancellation-corrected packet construction with residual-defect and pressure-channel obligations in view.
A no-go theorem proving that an entire class of alien invariants, reset mechanisms, or pressure channels cannot cross the PDE bridge.
A decisive reranking theorem showing which of Lean formalization, pressure taxonomy, packet construction, or alien invariant search has the lowest proof cost.
failure_modes: Restating the pincer exponent inequality or residual-defect Gronwall lemma as if it were new.
Using geometric or alien-math analogies without a PDE-facing inequality or falsifier.
Substituting a metric kernel for the Euclidean pressure operator without proof.
Calling velocity-only, boundary, forcing, or pressure-gauge artifacts pressure-channel mechanisms without explicit scope change.
Claiming Navier-Stokes regularity or blowup from a local invariant or packet result.
